scope: Benchmark-scoped amendment for formal ESConv generation and scoring only; CPCD v1 is unchanged.
input_history_rule: Preserve the exact strategy label on every prior supporter turn; never expose the target strategy.
target_output_rule: One strict JSON object with exactly strategy and non-empty response fields; any format error is an invalid strategy prediction.
format_retry_rule: At most one correction retry; persist and validate every raw output and request-message hash.
scoring_rule: Official pinned gold labels; Accuracy, Macro-F1, Weighted-F1, invalid rate; NLTK 3.9.4 word_tokenize lowercase and corpus_bleu method3; released ROUGE-L and Distinct behavior.
